client.title: City (for a single city)
client.description: Leave the Cities (multiple) field below empty to use this single-city shortcut instead. The client code is the subdomain of that city's Legistar site (seattle.legistar.com -> "seattle").

cities.title: Cities (multiple)
cities.description: For checking several cities in one run instead of one at a time. One entry per city, e.g. { "client": "seattle" }. Ignored if City above is filled in.

sinceDate.title: Matters introduced since
sinceDate.description: Only include legislative matters (ordinances, resolutions, etc.) introduced on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

keywordFilter.title: Keyword filter
keywordFilter.description: Only keep matters whose title contains one of these (case-insensitive). Leave empty for all matters.

matterTypeFilter.title: Matter type filter
matterTypeFilter.description: Only keep matters whose type exactly matches one of these (e.g. "Ordinance", "Resolution"). Leave empty for all types.

includeUpcomingMeetings.title: Include upcoming meetings
includeUpcomingMeetings.description: Also fetch each city's upcoming council/committee meetings (from today onward).
